It's not opacity, that's misleading. Also, it's not consistent across emulators, so we should note that. Perhaps something like...

```suggestion
	Modifier: Darken the text slightly. (Inconsistent across emulators; might do nothing)
```

But otherwise open to better suggestions (just not opacity 😅).
This is not entirely correct as Chalk also supports more colors: https://github.com/chalk/chalk#256-and-truecolor-color-support
Should I word that comment differently, or add more to the type?
Just make it clear that it's not the only available colors.

>Available builtin foreground colors. Other colors are also available: https://github.com/chalk/chalk/blob/master/readme.md#256-and-truecolor-color-support

Well, then the style guide should be amended.

Without them VS Code's popout doesn't preserve tab-indentation. I'm also not really interested in working around VS Code issues. Open a VS Code issue about this instead. I'm not going to change the style guide about this.
